threat_event: Contractor customers store CUI in SYS-D4 although it has not shown FedRAMP Moderate equivalency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 open 3PAO findings; no FedRAMP authorization; customers told it is "FedRAMP-ready"
existing_controls: Platform runs on a FedRAMP-authorized provider; SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Close findings; FedRAMP Moderate authorization path; written status notice to CUI tenants (group plan GR-05)

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect exposes one contractor tenant's CUI to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared application tier; isolation tested each release but not by an outside tester since 2025
existing_controls: Per-tenant databases and keys; release isolation tests
treatment_plan: Independent tenant isolation test twice a year; separate cluster for CUI tenants (done 2026-04)

threat_event: DoD edition Government-related data is reused to train the industry edition model
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026-05 model retraining combined DoD edition telemetry with industry data; no data-use gate
treatment_plan: Stop reuse; retrain without DoD data; data-use gate (group plan GR-18)

threat_event: Defense Software cannot file a DIBNet report in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DoD-approved medium assurance certificate holder in the division
existing_controls: Group SOC; Aircraft Parts certificate holders cannot file for Defense Software contracts
treatment_plan: Obtain certificates for 2 Defense Software staff; drill (group plan GR-07)

threat_event: A compromised dependency or pipeline secret ships malicious code to both editions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pipeline secrets in variables for 3 legacy jobs; no build provenance
treatment_plan: Move secrets to the vault; build provenance (group plan GR-16)

threat_event: Support engineers access CUI tenant data without a linked customer ticket
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAM approval does not require a ticket number
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked PAM approval; customer-visible access log

threat_event: A DoD edition outage stops daily readiness reporting for program offices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region; failover not tested in 2026
owner: Defense Software general manager, DoD edition

threat_event: Marketing claims ("FedRAMP-ready", "CMMC compliant") are found deceptive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website and proposals describe SYS-D4 with claims the evidence does not support
existing_controls: Legal review of new claims only
treatment_plan: Withdraw unsupported claims; legal review of all security claims

threat_event: A wrong predictive maintenance score leads to a poor maintenance decision
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model drift monitoring monthly; no independent validation since 2025
existing_controls: Maintainers decide; score never grounds or releases an aircraft by itself
treatment_plan: Independent validation before each model release (P10)

threat_event: Engineers send export-controlled source code to a coding assistant outside the approved boundary
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved assistant runs inside the government-community boundary; public assistants not blocked on all developer laptops
treatment_plan: Block public assistants on developer laptops (P10)
owner: Defense Software security and compliance lead

threat_event: The SOC 2 report has exceptions because model and feature changes skipped review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026-05 model change bypassed the release board data-use step
treatment_plan: Change gate with data-use and system description impact steps (P09)
owner: Defense Software security and compliance lead

threat_event: An offshore subprocessor gives a country of concern access to government-related data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No covered data transaction review documented
existing_controls: No offshore subprocessors with data access today
treatment_plan: Document the 28 CFR 202 review in vendor onboarding

threat_event: Classified data is uploaded into the DoD edition by a customer user
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Platform is not authorized for classified data
treatment_plan: Spillage procedure with the Contracting Officer (P08)
owner: Defense Software general manager, DoD edition

threat_event: Maintainer contact data in commercial tenants is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial tenants hold names and work contact details of maintainers
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5); state breach laws (generic)
treatment_plan: Accept: low sensitivity data, existing controls
owner: Defense Software security and compliance lead
